exposure: Colorectal cancer diagnosis in the postpartum period (< 6 months)
cohort: Eight patients diagnosed with colorectal cancer during pregnancy or in the postpartum period (< 6 months) between August 1997 and April 2013.
finding: There was a significant delay in the diagnosis of colorectal cancer, but surgery for colorectal cancer during pregnancy can be performed safely without compromising maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: All deliveries were at term, with two cesarean sections and one preterm delivery occurring following a low anterior resection at the 34th week of pregnancy.
